steps.title: Beams and legs
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).iam and save it as esp2026_seat_set.iam.
Place beam_tube.ipt, right click and Place Grounded: the front tube, on the origin line, 330 mm up. Place the rear tube 330 mm behind it (Mate with offset).
Place leg.ipt twice, 270 mm each side of the centre: Insert each bore on to its tube. Place beam_collar.ipt beside each leg boss. Place track_fitting.ipt and track_stud.ipt under each foot.
steps.note: The legs stand on the aircraft seat tracks; the studs lock into the tracks every 25.4 mm.

steps.title: Spreaders, end caps and baggage bar
actions: Place spreader.ipt on the tubes at x = -750 and Insert both bores. Pattern it: 4 along X, 500 mm apart.
Place beam_end_cap.ipt in the four tube ends, and baggage_bar.ipt through the front struts of the legs.
steps.note: The spreaders sit under the armrests, so each seat is 450 mm wide between the armrests.

steps.title: Seat pans and cushions
actions: Place seat_diaphragm.ipt on the tubes of the middle seat, then seat_foam.ipt and seat_cover.ipt.
Pattern the three parts: 3 along X, 500 mm apart, centred.

steps.title: Backs and pivot pins
actions: Place the back sub-assembly (back shell, cushion, cover, head rest) for each seat.
Insert back_pivot_pin.ipt through the two middle spreaders and end_pivot_pin.ipt through the end ones, through the lugs of the backs. Add an Angle constraint of 12 degrees for each back (upright).
steps.note: Each back turns on the pins: upright at 12 degrees from vertical, reclined at 17.

steps.title: Recline locks
actions: For each seat: place recline_bracket.ipt on the front tube, recline_lock.ipt and recline_rod.ipt, and pin both ends with lock_pin.ipt.

steps.title: Armrests
actions: Place armrest.ipt on the end spreader: Insert armrest_pin.ipt through the cheeks and the spreader. Add armrest_pad.ipt on top. Pattern: 4 along X, 500 mm apart.
Place recline_button.ipt on the front of the three armrests to the right of each seat.
steps.note: Each armrest lifts 90 degrees for access; the end ones let a passenger transfer from an aisle wheelchair.

steps.title: Seat belts
steps.command: Assemble tab > Component panel > Place from Content Center
actions: Place the belt anchors on the spreaders (two per seat, M10 bolts from Content Center), then the belt webbing, buckle, lever and tongue for each seat.

steps.title: Trays, screens, pockets and life vests
actions: Fit each back with its literature pocket, tray arms, tray, latch, screen and power module.
Place a vest_pouch.ipt with its life_vest.ipt under each seat.
Inspect tab > Interference > Analyze Interference upright, reclined, with the trays down and the armrests up: no parts overlap. Save.
steps.note: Each seat now has everything the product design specification asks for.
